a batch of small-size ingots with a mass of 23 – 25 kg each by the method of triple vacuum arc remelting
– uniform forging of the ingot aimed at crushing the cast structure;
– two-stage forming of the ingot first in the /c98-range and then in the (/c97+ /c98)-range in order to further refine the grains
– forming of billets in the ( /c97+ /c98)-range aimed at fabri - cation of preforms of the required shape and sizes
– final isothermal deformation (upsetting) of the blade preforms in the /c98-range
